::: {#exr-shared-memory}

#### A tensor that shares its array

[`torch.from_numpy`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.from_numpy.html) also makes a [tensor](#def-tensor) from a NumPy array.
Make one this way from a copy of `pixels`,
change an entry of the tensor,
and look at the same entry of the array.

:::
